# Generated by scripts/port_msgs_to_ros2.py; do not edit by hand.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(baxter_maintenance_msgs)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rosidl_default_generators REQUIRED)


rosidl_generate_interfaces(${PROJECT_NAME}
  "msg/CalibrateArmData.msg"
  "msg/CalibrateArmEnable.msg"
  "msg/TareData.msg"
  "msg/TareEnable.msg"
  "msg/UpdateSource.msg"
  "msg/UpdateSources.msg"
  "msg/UpdateStatus.msg"
)

# ros1_bridge finds this file through the <export> tag in package.xml.
install(FILES mapping_rules.yaml DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

ament_export_dependencies(rosidl_default_runtime)
ament_package()
